kept_items.author: ns123abc
kept_items.text: BREAKING: U.S. government will decide who gets access to GPT-5.6. OpenAI will release GPT-5.6 only in a limited preview to a small group of partners. Sam Altman told staff the government would be approving access customer by customer. Commerce Sec Lutnick personally involved.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strongest-engagement breaking summary of the GPT-5.6 government-gated release, naming Commerce Sec Lutnick. Anchor of the day's dominant story.

kept_items.author: steph_palazzolo
kept_items.text: New w/ @leomschwartz @amir: The Trump admin has asked OpenAI to stagger the release of GPT-5.6 over security concerns. On Thursday, CEO Sam Altman told staff that the government will be approving access to GPT-5.6 customer by customer, a highly unusual approach.
kept_items.selection_reason: The Information's original scoop from the reporting team; distinct angle (security concerns, staggered rollout) and highest view count on the story.

kept_items.author: AndrewCurran_
kept_items.text: I promised I would post the letter Dario Amodei sent to the White House and Senators Tim Scott and Elizabeth Warren as soon as it became available:
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete primary document: Amodei's letter to the White House and named senators, distinct policy angle within the regulation story.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: Work at OpenAI is being transformed by agents, in every department. Across our entire company, people are using Codex to do work that is more complex, longer-running, and increasingly cross-functional. Our internal usage offers an early look at how agentic tools may reshape work.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official OpenAI post detailing internal Codex adoption across departments; concrete company statement with strong engagement.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: We're joining @raiseus_ai as a founding partner. RAISE US is a nonprofit coalition working to strengthen the American workforce through employer-led action, AI-enabled training, and policy innovation to support the transition to transformative AI.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official Anthropic company move: founding partner of a workforce coalition. Concrete, distinct from the regulation story.

kept_items.author: 0xCodila
kept_items.text: Anthropic CEOs Dario and Daniela Amodei: We left OpenAI with 7 people. Everyone thought we were crazy. Three and a half years later - all 7 co-founders are still here. At OpenAI? Ask them how many are left.
kept_items.selection_reason: Widely-viewed Amodei quote contrasting co-founder retention at Anthropic vs OpenAI; strong practitioner-interest item with high views.

kept_items.author: testingcatalog
kept_items.text: DeepReinforce has released Ornith-1.0, their new self-improving family of open-source models designed for agentic coding. Ornith-1.0 learns to write its own task scaffolds during training rather than relying on human-designed harnesses. The 397B MoE flagship can match larger models.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source model release (Ornith-1.0, 397B MoE) for agentic coding; distinct release news in the open-weights space.

kept_items.author: Polymarket
kept_items.text: JUST IN: New study reveals LLM-based trading strategies mostly failed to outperform a simple buy-and-hold strategy over 20 years.
kept_items.selection_reason: High-engagement research finding on LLM trading underperformance over 20 years; concrete, widely-shared analysis item.

kept_items.author: bindureddy
kept_items.text: AI Can Build Complex Apps With Just One Single Prompt. New AI models may be banned but multi-LLM agents can build insane things. Here is our agent building an entire Slack-like app using a single prompt. Combines Opus, GPT 5.5 and open-source LLMs to optimize cost.
kept_items.selection_reason: High-view demonstration of a multi-model agent building a full app from one prompt; concrete practitioner/product item distinct from official releases.

kept_items.author: zodchiii
kept_items.text: A Stanford team just published the 16-page PDF on How to structure an AI agent. Structure matters more than how you prompt it, and it's backed by hard numbers. Build, Reflect, Curate, Reuse.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete research artifact (Stanford agent-structure paper) with a clear framework; useful technical analysis, distinct topic.

kept_items.author: JonhernandezIA
kept_items.text: Google DeepMind CEO, Demis Hassabis: AGI is now at the edge of the singularity. Cyber is only the first warning shot. Bio and nuclear risks may come within 2 years. That's just a warning shot for humanity. AGI safety now needs global standards.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strongest-engagement Hassabis item; concrete safety-timeline claims (bio/nuclear within 2 years), distinct from policy and product stories.
